text:
maya: FYI CI publish is failing on the typegen pipeline, blocking the SDK release. npm refused to publish because of a version mismatch. 

maya: CI error snippet:
```
Error: Version mismatch: package.json version 1.4.0 != release tag v1.4.1
npm ERR! refused to publish
Exit code: 1
```

maya: repro steps in case someone wants to run locally: `yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-typegen build && ./scripts/release-cli stamp && yarn publish --access public` — it fails at the publish step.

ci-bot: Build #2748: https://ci.internal/redwood/2748 — typegen-publish step failed (see logs). :warning:

jon: I think this is the same mismatch we saw last week but with a different root cause. That one was changelog automation stamping the tag after the package.json bumped.

lee: Quick sanity check — which repo authored the release tag? release-bot or the release workflow?

release-bot: Automated release: created tag v1.4.1 for PR #452 by @release-workflow at 2026-11-05T14:02:10Z

arjun: Hmm, looks like the tag was created by the release workflow before the typegen job updated package.json. The release order got inverted when the new stamp step landed.

tasha: Could this be related to the recent stamp change that tries to infer semver from merged PR labels? We added a fast path to skip package.json writes in some cases.

maya: That sounds plausible. The failing run shows the stamp step ran on the release job (tag v1.4.1) but the checked-out workspace still had package.json 1.4.0. So publish sees mismatch and aborts.

jon: Options: 1) revert the fast-path in stamp; 2) make publish read the tag instead of package.json; 3) ensure stamp step mutates workspace before tag creation (preferred).

lee: I vote (3) — stamp then tag then push. Reverting faster but more disruptive.

arjun: Agreed. I can put a hotfix that performs stamp as an explicit step in the release workflow and re-run the failed job.

maya: Thanks — if you run a hotfix, can you also add a guard in the publish script to print both values before failing so the error is easier to triage next time?

arjun: yes will do. quick patch in #459 to add debug print, stamp ordering fix in #460.

ci-bot: re-run queued: triggered rebuild for #2748 by @arjun — rebuilding typegen publish.

jon: Also, we had a minor regen diff in the type declarations in the sample app that was gated by typegen changes — not sure if that caused any ordering or if it's just noise. @maya can you confirm sample app tests passed?

maya: sample-app tests are green locally. regen diff looked like whitespace plus arg rename in an optional param; not a semver reason. I pushed the trivial fix to keep the branch clean.

tasha: Once arjun's fix lands, can we add a CI assertion that package.json and tag are identical before publish? Even a non-blocking warning helps.

arjun: yep adding pre-publish assert + debug logging in #460. I'll also add a small integration test in the release workflow.

release-bot: Rebuild succeeded: typegen publish passed (build #2748 rerun) — tag v1.4.1 now matches package.json 1.4.1. :tada:

maya: awesome, thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) ship #460 (stamp order and assert), 2) one-line logging change (maya suggestion), 3) retro note about release stamp fast-path in next devex sync.

jon: marking as done for now. i'll add checklist items to the release runbook. :white_check_mark:
